title: Agent harness self-serve policy
description: Written and signed only by the user-run enabler at ~/.agent-harness/policy/self-serve.json (mode 0600). Verified by harness/hooks/self_serve.py, which returns no grant on any failure. The signature is Ed25519 over the bytes 'agent-harness-self-serve-policy/1' + NUL + canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, ASCII) of this object without 'signature'. The key must be pinned in ~/.agent-harness/policy/self-serve-pubkeys.json for purpose 'self-serve'; a central-decisions key never verifies. A file named 'disabled' in the same directory, or a file under 'revoked/' named 'all', the policy id or 'cap-<capability>', refuses the matching grants at once.

key_id.description: First 16 hex of sha256('agent-harness-self-serve-key' + NUL + raw public key).

capabilities.description: Closed list. A key outside it makes the whole policy invalid. Hard rules 1 to 4, accounts, passwords, payments and CAPTCHA have no capability and no field.

disabled.description: Capabilities switched off by the user (--disable). Wins over 'capabilities'.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of each grant, clamped to the policy expiry. Null means the policy expiry.

scope.description: Returned to the caller inside the grant. The library enforces repos, denylist_paths and single_use; other keys are enforced by the consuming guard.

repos.description: owner/name list; evidence.repo must be a member.

denylist_paths.description: Globs (case-insensitive); evidence.changed_paths is required and none may match.

single_use.description: Needs evidence.use_key; the same (policy, capability, use_key) is granted once.
